gpa.quote: You may be admitted with an international diploma if it is equivalent to a Dutch VWO diploma with the correct subjects.
gpa.notes: No grade minimum: diploma equivalence with VWO (Maths B) plus a numerus fixus 'Matching & Selection procedure' ('A numerus fixus has been set for the Computer Science & Engineering programme.
